questions.question: Which controls should import mode present?
questions.answer: Only controls that affect import: Local file and Import settings; hide Download name, Target profile, Export scope, and Format
questions.notes: User said export options should not show while importing and asked us to choose which ones.

questions.question: Should import settings remain available?
options: Keep Local file and Import settings (Recommended)
questions.assumed: Keep Local file and Import settings

questions.question: Is Download name relevant while importing?
Which controls belong to Export Model?
options: Download name, target, scope, and format (Recommended)
questions.assumed: Download name, Target profile, Export scope, and Format

questions.question: Which controls belong to Open Project?
Which controls belong to Save Project and Save As?
What happens when the same dialog switches actions?
questions.assumed: Reapply the complete visibility matrix each time it opens

questions.question: Should a hidden option's label also disappear?
Should switching modes erase values in hidden output fields?
questions.assumed: Preserve values so returning to export does not lose choices

questions.question: Should selecting Import still open the native picker immediately?
options: Wait for another click in the dialog
questions.assumed: Keep the existing native picker flow

questions.question: Should job progress and status stay visible in every mode?
options: Hide them until a job starts
questions.assumed: Keep progress and status visible in every mode

questions.question: Should unsaved-change confirmation change?
Should fields animate when modes change?
questions.assumed: Switch immediately with no new motion

questions.question: How should hidden fields behave for assistive technology?
options: Remove them from the accessibility tree (Recommended)
questions.assumed: Remove hidden fields from the accessibility tree

questions.question: Should the dialog title continue naming the active action?
Should native dialog focus and Escape behavior change?
questions.assumed: Leave native dialog focus and Escape behavior intact

questions.question: Which mode transitions need rendered-browser coverage?
questions.assumed: Cover import and export visibility in a real browser

questions.question: Should this change alter import/export payloads?
options: Remove hidden fields from payload construction
questions.assumed: Visibility only; preserve all existing operation payloads

questions.question: Should the visibility rules differ by screen size?
questions.assumed: Use the same mode rules at every viewport size

questions.question: What should an unknown future action show?
questions.assumed: Hide all action-specific fields while retaining universal status and actions
